name: @repo/scroll-image-reveal
description: An image revealed by an animated mask as it scrolls into view, with a counter-parallax on the image.

useCases: Editorial image reveals inside a long-form article
Hero image that wipes or irises into view on scroll
Gallery entries with a counter-parallax depth effect
compositionHints: Drive multiple instances from a shared scroll container via the container prop
Pair with scroll-reveal-paragraph for a matching editorial rhythm
